messages:
Nina: Heads up — console shows ~300 reqs attributed to project:unknown for org-sentinel between 09:12-09:30. billing team flagged a mismatch. sample req id: b7c4d1. Upstream header had x-origin-project:events but auth-introspect returned no project claim.
Harpreet: thanks. sounds like an introspect fail path. can you paste the quicklog?
Nina: quicklog:
```
ts=1718801260 req=b7c4d1 headers={x-origin-project:events} auth_introspect={status:502,msg:"bad gateway"} routing_path=fallback:org-only
```
Joel: pattern we saw before. short-term: preserve header as soft-attribution (keep project bucket for UX) and emit telemetry fields `attr_origin=header|introspect`, `attr_confidence=high|soft|none`, and `attr_reason=introspect_error|missing_claim|ok`. long-term: harden introspect SLOs.
Harpreet: agree. accounting prefers not to bill soft-attributed traffic immediately. propose attr-janitor worker to reconcile soft->authoritative within 48h and publish `billing_reassign` events with {req_id, old_attr, new_attr, reconciled_at}.
billing-bot: please ensure audit event for any billing_reassign and include admin_ack if pin override used; accounting needs the stream for retro-charge.
infra-bot: created ticket ENG-7801 (telemetry + schema) and ENG-7802 (router soft-attr flag + janitor). alert rule "introspect_5xx_rate" set to 0.5%/5m.
Nina: owners: Harpreet (telemetry + alert), Joel (router flag + janitor), Billing (retro-charge schema). timeline: telemetry + alert today, router flag this week, janitor prototype next week. I'll file RFC and post updates here.
Joel: will prototype `soft_preserve=true` behind FF and add audit emit when reconciled.
Harpreet: pushing schema PR now.
Nina: thanks team :thumbsup:
